differences.what: A's horn renders as an opaque mirror-chrome blob with a hard pink/maroon reflection split, reading as a different material from the clear acrylic cabinet; B's horn is a consistent translucent red with the driver visible through it
B's cabinet edges are crisply defined by dark acrylic edge lines and the side handle cutout reads clearly; in A the right side and edges dissolve into red glow against the black set
Base ports, screw holes and inner box are legible in B; in A the internal block is blown to flat pink and the ports are muddy
A's dark set with glossy floor reflection and rim glow gives mood and grounding; B's white sweep is flat, slightly cyan-grey, with almost no contact shadow so the speaker looks pasted on
Both frame the product small with large empty margins; A's black void wastes more of the frame and the horizon glow is a cheap gradient
B's horn mounting rods show a dark smear running down from the driver into the rod, reading as a leak or artifact
